candidates.observed_friction: Agent 2's real replay used one Click virtual environment across commits; two older commits then failed collection under pytest 9.1.1 and required a manual 9.0.2 pin.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: Historical test replay needs a new compatibility resolver or ad-hoc dependency pinning.
candidates.simpler_approach: At the target commit, synchronize its tracked uv.lock before running the test.
candidates.problem_evidence: docs/usefulness/traces/testsel-trace.txt records PytestRemovedIn10Warning at Click 748a34d0 and the later pytest==9.0.2 repair.
candidates.potential_value: Avoid classifying dependency drift as a code failure during historical reproduction.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Fresh-checkout the target commit, run uv sync --group tests --locked, then rerun the previously blocked focused test.
candidates.cost: One external clone, locked environment setup and one focused test.

candidates.observed_friction: Agent 2 found two changed lines that the full suite did not detect.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: A selector can solve missing test sensitivity.
candidates.simpler_approach: Manual one-line mutation with existing pytest tooling.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Replay one mutation against the existing suite.
candidates.cost: Already investigated by Agent 2 and excluded by the current gate.

candidates.observed_friction: A collection error can be mistaken for a product regression.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: The native pytest error is too ambiguous for an agent to choose a repair.
candidates.simpler_approach: Read pytest's exception class and the repository's dependency lock.
candidates.problem_evidence: The trace names PytestRemovedIn10Warning and filterwarnings=error rather than an assertion failure.
candidates.potential_value: Reduce unsafe retries and false defect reports.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Check whether the existing output plus lock identifies the compatibility repair without normalization.
candidates.cost: No extra run beyond the selected compatibility replay; weaker evidence for a new error format.

selected_plan.observed_problem: Reproduce a historical focused test without a newer shared environment causing a collection failure unrelated to the commit.
selected_plan.baseline: Observed Agent 2 baseline: a venv provisioned at Click HEAD, then reused at 748a34d0; pytest 9.1.1 produced one collection error and selected no meaningful test result.
selected_plan.hypothesis: Synchronizing the target commit's tracked uv.lock with the repository-native uv command will reduce collection errors from 1 to 0 and pass the focused test without an ad-hoc version guess.
selected_plan.quality_control: The exact focused test file used in Agent 2's case must collect and pass at the unmodified target commit; the installed pytest version must come from the target lock, not a manually chosen pin.
selected_plan.overhead: Clone, lock synchronization, package downloads, test execution, trace writing, lab verification and publication are included.
selected_plan.stop_condition: If the native locked setup removes the collection error, record a practice-level simplification and build no helper. If locked setup fails, record the blocker as inconclusive; do not loosen dependencies post hoc.

result.setup: uv sync created .venv, resolved 81 packages, prepared and installed 32 packages; named downloads totaled 61.1 MiB.
result.interpretation: The one-error improvement validates a repository-native historical-replay practice, not a new tool. The earlier failure came from reusing a newer environment across commits; target-lock synchronization removed it without guessing a version.

decision.reason: For historical external-repository replays, synchronize the target commit's tracked lock before tests. Build no compatibility resolver or error normalizer from this case.

limitations: The baseline comes from Agent 2's earlier trace while the intervention used a fresh checkout, so order, cache and runtime differ.
This replay covers one Click commit and one uv lock; it does not establish behavior for projects without locks or other package managers.
The locked setup downloaded 61.1 MiB of named packages and installed 32 packages, so correctness did not remove cold-start cost.
A passing focused file does not replace the repository's full historical CI matrix.
